name: Tesla Mini Bot
description: Modular WhatsApp bot with persistent PostgreSQL auth storage. Requires an external PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL.

OWNER_NUMBERS.description: Comma-separated owner numbers in international digits-only format.

PAIRING_NUMBER.description: Optional phone number in international digits only; used only for the first WhatsApp pairing.

SESSION_ID.description: Optional PostgreSQL auth-session namespace. Leave unset to reuse the existing default session; set a stable label to isolate another linked WhatsApp session.
